prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic, close-up shot of a vintage industrial control panel, focusing on three large black rotary switches mounted on a muted olive-green metal surface. Above the switches, a horizontal strip features red and white labels with German text, including "AUSSER BETRIEB," "WEICHEN," "SIGNALE," and "GLEISKREISE." The background reveals additional mechanical components and glass-encased electronics, softly blurred to emphasize depth of field. The lighting is low and moody, casting gentle reflections and subtle shadows that evoke a sense of nostalgia and technical precision. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy greens, deep blacks, and warm highlights, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of mid-20th-century engineering environments. The composition is symmetrical and tightly framed, drawing attention to the tactile details and utilitarian design of the machinery.
